author: ETA PRIME
description:
Walmart’s new $288 Onn 13.2" Tablet Pro might just be one of the best budget Android tablets of the year! Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300 with 8GB of RAM, this massive 120Hz IPS display is surprisingly snappy. In this video, we unbox the tablet, check out the included folio case and active stylus, and put the performance to the test.

Get The onn 13" Pro Tablet Here: https://howl.link/6uw2gc37ffewu

Buy the new 20262026 onn 11" Core Tablet: https://howl.link/nh0pw6u3i4kjx
Buy the 8.1 Core Android table Here: https://howl.link/16dza5l3v83q1
2026 Onn 7" Tablet : https://howl.link/lg6ycyve7vnnv

We push this budget beast to its limits with native Android gaming like Fortnite and PUBG, plus we test out some heavy emulation including PSP (PPSSPP), GameCube (Dolphin), and PS2 (NetherSX2). It even has Widevine L1 for HD streaming on Netflix and can act as a portable monitor via USB-C video input! Is this the ultimate price-to-performance tablet? Let's find out!
